verdict.rationale: Square publishes a Disputes API (retrieve disputes, process them, sandbox testing) and its MCP server's service catalog explicitly includes 'disputes' alongside a generic make_api_request tool, so an agent could plausibly retrieve a dispute and call dispute-related endpoints programmatically. However, there is no documented evidence-assembly workflow (e.g., specific evidence-submission endpoint, required evidence fields) or any hands-on/community example of an agent completing a dispute end-to-end via the API or MCP. missing for 10: explicit evidence-submission API details, a demonstrated end-to-end agent workflow, and independent confirmation the MCP disputes tools work as claimed.
